title: SDK Quickstart Visual Library — Auth Key Rotation, Streaming Timeline, and Tool-Call Sequences
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a cohesive visual asset library for the SDK/API quickstart docs focusing on three prioritized flows: 1) API key lifecycle & rotation UX (console + CLI), 2) streaming response timeline with token-level progress/latency annotations, and 3) tool-calling sequence diagrams with structured output examples. Assets should be modular for use in Markdown docs, hosted quickstarts, and the Console help panel.
tasks: Audit existing onboarding imagery to avoid duplication (drive: /Design/Onboarding/2024)
Design 6 variants for API key rotation: console modal, toast, CLI snippet, security best-practices callout, expired-key flow, key-rotation animation
Design streaming timeline frames: idle -> handshake -> first-token -> steady-stream -> truncated/failure handling (5 frames + animated GIF)
Design tool-calling storyboard: request -> tool-dispatch -> tool-response -> structured output validation -> fallback path
Produce light/dark versions and 2x/@3x PNGs + SVG source for each asset
Write companion microcopy for tooltips and docs captions (PM review required)
Export a single-page reference PDF for external partners and the solutions team
acceptance_criteria: All assets exported in PNG (1x/2x), SVG, and an animated GIF for streaming demo
Figma files linked and published with component library tokens (typography, color, spacing)
PM sign-off on copy and sequence correctness (Maya Chen)
Eng verification that code snippets match runtime behavior (Henri Kline)
Accessibility check: color contrast meets AA for callouts and overlays
Assets added to docs repo under docs/assets/quickstart/sdk-visuals with a README
progress_updates: 2025-02-11: Kickoff completed; synced with PM (Maya) and Eng lead (Henri). Agreed to prioritize animated streaming demo and key-rotation modal.
2025-02-13: First draft frames uploaded to Figma. API snippet for streaming updated per engineering notes (Henri).
2025-02-15: Accessibility pass done — contrast tweaks to callout colors. Added aria-label guidance in microcopy.
2025-02-17: Internal design review: Ravi to iterate on key rotation animation timing; suggested reducing easing to 220ms for perceived responsiveness.
2025-02-20: PR created to docs repo with placeholder assets; awaiting PM copy sign-off and Eng verification of final CLI examples.
review_feedback: Henri Kline (Eng): Confirm streaming snippet uses chunked transfer + keep-alive; current visual shows an implied retry that does not match runtime — please adjust.

Maya Chen (PM): Microcopy for 'Rotate Key' callout reads too technical for beginners. Suggested change: 'Rotate keys regularly to reduce exposure' -> 'Rotate keys regularly to keep your integration secure.'
Security (review note): Add a short note about KMS/HSM integration in the key-rotation doc block; link to compliance page.
Design Lead (Ravi Patel): Reduce complexity of the tool-call storyboard to four frames and use numbered badges for step clarity.
notes: Trade-off: Animated GIFs demonstrate streaming clearly on docs but increase repo size; we'll host large GIFs on CDN (docs-assets.redwood.ai) and keep lightweight PNGs in repo.
Decision: Use a token-progress bar with subtle shimmer rather than per-token counters to avoid confusion about pricing semantics.
Localization: Leave 25px vertical padding on text overlays to account for languages with taller glyphs during i18n.
Follow-up: Create a short Loom demo for the Solutions team showing how to embed the GIF and reference the CLI snippets. Owner: Ava.
